title: Starter · Wingspan

environment.description: A high alpine valley in summer: granite peaks with snowfields, a river winding through green meadows into a turquoise lake, pine forest, clear sky with soft clouds.
environment.style: Photoreal nature documentary. Golden late-morning sun, crisp air, deep focus on wides, natural colour.

entities.name: Alpine lake
entities.notes: Clear turquoise glacial lake reflecting the peaks.

entities.name: Pine tree
entities.notes: Tall subalpine fir and pine trees, dark green, dense.

entities.name: Elk 1
entities.notes: A real wild bull elk, a living animal on four legs grazing at a lakeshore: tan body, dark brown neck mane, large antlers. Not a person, not a costume, no clothing, no vest.
entities.styleNotes: Wildlife photograph of the living animal in natural light, no studio props

entities.name: Bald eagle
entities.notes: A real wild bald eagle, a living bird photographed in flight: dark brown body, broad wings with splayed primary feathers, white head and tail, yellow hooked beak and talons. Not a person, not a costume, not a mascot, no harness, no clothing.
entities.styleNotes: Wildlife photograph of the living animal in natural light, feathers sharp, no studio props

entities.name: Alpine terrain
entities.notes: Summer alpine valley: green meadows and wildflowers on the valley floor, pine forest on the lower slopes, grey granite ridges and peaks with snowfields above.

shots.title: The valley
shots.description: Sweeping aerial over the lake and peaks as a tiny @bald-eagle glides down from the ridge.

shots.title: The dive
shots.description: FPV drone chase locked right behind @bald-eagle as it folds its wings and dives down the river canyon, the camera rolling with every bank, treetops whipping past underneath.

shots.title: The swoop
shots.description: Low tracking shot at the lakeshore as @bald-eagle skims the water past the grazing @elk-herd and climbs away.
